summary: Steep, narrow residential kerb with homes 14-15 m back on the east side.
reasons: Homes 14-15 m away on own side

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14-15 m east of the kerb behind trees; more homes across the road; no open ground.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; cars park along the west side and a few on the east, but the east verge is tree-lined and tight, so room to pull fully off is uncertain.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street off a junction; light local traffic likely.
drivers.convention: 2P parallel, Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted, so overnight is outside the signed hours; cars park along both sides.

flags: Steep: about 10% grade, mean 9.5% over the stretch
Narrow lane with parked cars, tight for a van
Mapped gate 110 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on both sides; shaded for most of the day.
cannot_judge: Whether a van fits between parked cars

best_section.where: East kerb of Woodstock Avenue, 25 m south of the corner
